title: National teams with the most World Cup match wins
prompt: Name the 10 men's national football teams that have won the most World Cup matches (all time, through 2026)

source.name: Wikipedia: FIFA World Cup records and statistics

fact.text: The only team to play at every World Cup, and the only one to win it on four continents.

answers.name: Germany
aliases: West Germany men's national football team

fact.text: Gottfried Fuchs scored 10 goals in one game for Germany in 1912, a world record until 2001.
No team has won more official international titles: 23, among them a record 16 Copa Américas.
Winning in 1934 and 1938, it was the first team to defend the World Cup title.
Just Fontaine scored 13 goals for France at the 1958 World Cup, a record that still stands.

answers.name: England
aliases: The Current England national football squad

fact.text: The only World Cup winner never to win its own continent's title, and the only one that isn't a sovereign state.
Winning in 2026 made it the first country to hold the men's and women's World Cups at once.
Its 2006 game with Portugal, the Battle of Nuremberg, set a World Cup record of four red cards.
Its 1950 final win over Brazil drew 173,850 people, still the record for an official football match.
The only team to top the FIFA ranking without ever winning a World Cup or a continental trophy.
